==Description==
'''Speedy Enemies''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Healthy Enemies]] and before [[Glass]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

'''Speedy Enemies''' is part of a group of six modifiers consisting of itself, [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Committed]], [[Glass]] and [[Flying Enemies]]. These six modifiers cannot have their total reward boost exceed 50%, limiting their boosts to that. This does not prevent modifiers not part of this group from applying their boosts. For example, [[Fog]] will still apply its 20% reward boost when all six are applied, increasing the reward boost from 50% to 70%, though still lower from the expected 95%.

==Effects==
When applied, enemies will gain [[Nimble]], doubling their speed.

==Trivia==
*'''Speedy Enemies''' is a slightly modernized version of the [[Vanguard (Modifier)|Vanguard]] modifier, acting as the [[Challenge Trials]] replacement for it.
